name: Pionex
notes: Centralized exchange. TVL is custodial wallet holdings; no public EVM-style on-chain indexer applicable. No github handle in source.

name: Renzo

repos.verified: Cloned messari/subgraphs; renzo deployment config references RestakeManager 0x74a09653a083691711cf8215a6ab074bb4e99ef5 (canonical Renzo mainnet) + DepositQueue 0xf2f305d14dcd8aaef887e0428b3c9534795d0d60, plus per-chain deployment dirs.

notes: No official subgraph in Renzo-Protocol org (only contracts-public + adapter forks). Community-standard Messari subgraph verified indexing Renzo contracts.

name: Aera V3
notes: aera-finance org has only aera-contracts-public + a forked euler-price-oracle; no subgraph/indexer repo. Not present in Messari subgraphs. No public indexer found.

name: dYdX V4

repos.scope: Official dYdX v4 Indexer: microservices (ender, vulcan, socks, comlink, roundtable, bazooka) ingesting on/off-chain events into Postgres; serves trades/orderbook/candles APIs.
repos.verified: WebFetch of v4-chain/indexer dir confirms full indexer service suite for dYdX v4 chain trading/orderbook data; repo active (328 stars, recent PRs).

notes: dYdX v4 is a Cosmos appchain; the official custom indexer (not a subgraph) is the canonical data layer.

name: Vault Bridge
notes: agglayer/vault-bridge is ERC-4626 contracts only. agglayer/agglayer-bridge-hub-api is a generic Agglayer unified-bridge deposit/claim indexer (active) but not Vault-Bridge-specific. No dedicated Vault Bridge subgraph/indexer found.

name: Usual USD0
notes: Usual runs a subgraph-based yield-distribution engine via Ormi Labs (private/managed, no public repo). Messari has a 'usual' subgraph but it only indexes the USYC token (verified: only USYC.json ABI/datasource), not USD0/USD0++. No public USD0 indexer repo confirmed.

name: Hyperlane

repos.scope: Official Hyperlane Scraper agent (Rust): indexes Hyperlane interchain messages and CCR swaps into a Postgres DB (message/delivered_message tables).
repos.verified: WebFetch confirms scraper agent indexing Hyperlane messages/CCR swaps into DB; monorepo active (471 open issues, 399 PRs).

notes: Official Hyperlane monorepo contains the canonical message indexer (Rust scraper agent). Not a subgraph but a maintained custom indexer.

name: R25
notes: New institutional RWA protocol (rcUSD) primarily on Pharos (also Polygon, Sui). No github handle in source; no public subgraph/indexer repo found. Permissioned/curated RWA vaults.

name: Frax Ether
notes: FraxFinance org has only fraxswap-subgraph and fns-subgraph (neither covers frxETH/sfrxETH). frxETH-public is contracts only. Not in Messari subgraphs. No public frxETH/sfrxETH indexer found.

name: Balancer V3

repos.scope: Official Balancer v3 vault + pools subgraphs (monorepo, pnpm workspaces), multi-network.
repos.verified: WebFetch confirms official balancer org monorepo with subgraphs/ dir, vault & pools subgraph manifests (v10), 321 commits, docs for extending to new networks/pool types.

notes: Official Balancer v3 subgraph repo.

name: Bitlayer YBTC Family
notes: BitVM bridge / wrapped-BTC. Public repos exist for contracts (bitlayer-org/bitvm-bridge, bitvm-bridge-contracts) and Bitlayer docs describe generic Graph/subgraph support for builders, but no public YBTC-specific subgraph/indexer repo found. BTC wrapper bridge.

name: Apollo Diversified Credit Securitize Fund
notes: Tokenized private-credit feeder fund (ACRED/sACRED) via Securitize sToken standard, permissioned/custodial, primarily Solana plus other chains. No public subgraph/indexer repo found.

name: Ourbit
notes: Centralized exchange. Custodial wallet holdings; no public on-chain indexer applicable. No github handle in source.

name: The Vault Liquid Staking
notes: Solana-only liquid staking (SPL stake-pool style). No public EVM-style subgraph; data exposed via Solana stake-pool program. No dedicated public indexer repo found.

name: Strata Markets
notes: Strata-Markets org has only 'contracts' (ERC-4626 tranche vaults) and a release-reports repo; no subgraph/indexer. Not in Messari subgraphs. No public indexer found.

name: fx Protocol

notes: No official subgraph in AladdinDAO org (only fx-sdk). Messari subgraph verified indexing f(x) v2 contracts.

name: Rhea Lend
notes: NEAR-based lending (ex-Burrow, merged into Rhea/Ref). ref-finance org has SDKs; a community NEAR subgraph exists (VitalPointAI/subgraph-ref-finance) but covers the Ref DEX, not the Burrow/Rhea lending market. No verified public lending indexer found.

name: Avalon CeDeFi
notes: BTC-backed CeDeFi lending/CDP (USDa). No public subgraph/indexer repo found in searches; not in Messari subgraphs. Hybrid CeFi/DeFi with off-chain components.

name: JPool
notes: Solana-only liquid staking pool (SPL stake-pool fork by mfactory-lab). jpool-pub repo is public assets only; core data via SPL stake-pool program. No public EVM-style subgraph / dedicated indexer repo.

name: OSL
notes: Regulated centralized exchange/custodian. Custodial holdings; no public on-chain indexer applicable. No github handle in source.

name: Benqi Lending

repos.scope: Benqi lending market (Comptroller + qiTokens) on Avalanche.
repos.verified: Cloned messari/subgraphs; benqi compound-fork config references Comptroller 0x486Af39519B4Dc9a7fCcd318217352830E8AD9b4 (canonical Benqi Avalanche) startBlock 3046286; template Comptroller datasource.

notes: No official subgraph in benqi-fi org (and Messari benqi-staked-avax covers only the LST, not lending). Messari compound-forks subgraph verified indexing the Benqi lending Comptroller on Avalanche.

name: NEAR Intents

repos.scope: Official high-performance Rust indexer for NEAR Intents: processes on-chain Intents/Verifier events and stores them (ClickHouse).
repos.verified: WebFetch of defuse-protocol org confirms rust-near-indexer described as 'A high-performance Rust indexer for NEAR Intents that processes blockchain events'; org also has blocksapi-rs streaming NEAR blocks.

notes: NEAR Intents (Defuse) is NEAR-based; official custom Rust indexer in the defuse-protocol org is the canonical data layer.

name: Re7 Labs
notes: Vault curator on Morpho, Euler, Silo, Mellow, Kamino across many chains. No own protocol contracts/indexer; underlying positions are indexed by the host protocols' subgraphs (Morpho/Euler/etc). No dedicated Re7 Labs subgraph/indexer repo found.

name: Sky RWA

repos.scope: MakerDAO/Sky core (Vat, Jug, Dog, etc.) on Ethereum; Vat-level indexing captures all collateral ilks including RWA collateral.
repos.verified: Cloned messari/subgraphs; makerdao template indexes Vat (handleVatFrob/handleVatGrab/handleVatFold), Jug, Dog datasources. Vat-level coverage includes RWA ilks (RWA collateral positions are recorded via Vat frob/grab).

notes: No standalone 'Sky RWA' subgraph; RWA collateral is part of the Maker/Sky Vat. Official sky-ecosystem org has rwa-toolkit (contracts only). Messari makerdao subgraph indexes the Vat which covers RWA ilks. Marked true on that basis (scope is whole Maker/Sky system, not RWA-isolated).
